component.name: RiffTag
component.summary: Tag, rename and check your music before you release it

description.p: RiffTag is a music tag editor for people who manage their own libraries and release their own records. It shows your files in a real folder structure and lets you edit them like a spreadsheet.

ul.li: Rename files and folders from their tags using templates, with a preview of every change before anything moves
Read tags back out of existing file names
Edit a whole album at once, changing only the fields you tick
Manage cover art, including drag and drop, and folder.jpg in and out
Fetch album details from MusicBrainz or Discogs
Clean lyrics up for streaming delivery and time them to the music as an .lrc
Convert between MP3, FLAC, WAV and M4A without touching the originals
Play your files while you work, with a proper transport
Run a release check that reports what a distributor would send back: artwork that is too small, inconsistent album artists, gaps in the track numbering, loudness and true peak, and more

description.p: It reads and writes ID3v2, iTunes MP4 atoms, Vorbis comments, APEv2 and Windows Media tags, covering mp3, flac, wav, aiff, ogg, opus, m4a, wma, dsf, ape, wv and mpc.

description.p: Built-in player, format conversion, lyrics cleanup and tap-to-sync, cover art by drag and drop, and the release check.
First release: tagging, renaming, and album lookup.
